auth.tagline: Split every paycheck automatically and always know what's safe to spend until your next payday.
auth.exploreDemoHint: A read-only tour with fictitious data — no sign-up needed.

rules.title: Distribution rules
rules.description: How every fixed income is split. Changes apply only to incomes registered from the effective date on; past splits never change.
rules.noRule: No rule yet. Set your percentages to start splitting your income automatically.
rules.vehiclesHint: How the Investment share is divided between your platforms. Must add up to 100%.
rules.noVehicles: You don't have investment vehicles yet. Create one to split your Investment share.
rules.subrulesRequired: Add at least one investment vehicle, or set Investment to 0%.
rules.duplicateVehicle: Each vehicle can appear only once.
rules.invalidPercent: Enter a percentage between 0 and 100 (up to 2 decimals).
rules.saved: Rule saved. It applies to incomes from {date}.
rules.effectiveTomorrow: Today's rule was already used by an income, so this change takes effect tomorrow ({date}).
rules.conflict: That date's rule is already used by incomes. Try again tomorrow.

income.title: Income
income.description: Every fixed income is split automatically by your rules into the quincena it funds.
income.label: Description
income.splitQuestion: How should this one-off income be recorded?
income.previewInvalid: Enter a valid amount to preview the split.
income.noRuleTitle: No distribution rule for this date
income.noRuleHint: Configure your percentages first, or record this income without splitting.
income.deleteHint: Its allocations are removed too and every balance is recalculated.
income.saveFailed: The income couldn't be saved. Try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.paydayIn: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to payday
dashboard.overspentHint: {buckets} went over budget. You can keep recording expenses; the deficit carries over to the next quincena.
dashboard.emptyHint: Register your income to see how much is safe to spend this quincena.

expenses.addDescription: It's taken from Needs or Wants depending on its category.
expenses.noCategoriesYet: Your categories are being prepared — try again in a moment.
expenses.saveFailed: The expense couldn't be saved. Try again.
expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Everything you've spent and every card payment. Card purchases count against your budget the day you make them.
expenses.deleteHint: Every balance is recalculated, including past quincenas.
expenses.payCardDescription: It lowers the card's debt. It doesn't touch Needs or Wants: the purchases already did.

recurring.title: Recurring expenses
recurring.description: Rent, internet, subscriptions… They're reserved from the first day of their quincena and charged automatically on their day.
recurring.addHint: It's charged every month on its day, from the start date on.
recurring.editHint: Changes only apply to future charges; past ones stay as they were.
recurring.name: Name
recurring.chargeDayHint: 1–31. Days that don't exist in a month (e.g. 31) are charged on its last day.
recurring.saveFailed: It couldn't be saved. Try again.
recurring.chargeDayLast: Every month on day {day} (or the last day)
recurring.paused: Paused. It won't be charged again until you resume it.
recurring.resumed: Resumed from today. Paused months aren't charged.
recurring.deleteHint: Future charges stop. Charges already applied stay in your history.

receivables.title: Receivables
receivables.description: Every MSI purchase you made with your card for someone else. They're kept out of your budget; collect each installment before your card is due.
receivables.addDescription: It goes on your card, but it's not your expense: it never touches Needs or Wants.
receivables.empty: No purchases for third parties yet.
receivables.previewHint: Fill in the total, months and card to see the calendar.
receivables.saved: Purchase saved with its collection calendar.
receivables.saveFailed: It couldn't be saved. Try again.
receivables.earmarked: This money is earmarked for paying {card}. It doesn't add to your Safe-to-Spend.
receivables.alertsTitle: {count, plural, one {# collection due} other {# collections due}}
receivables.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
receivables.debtorRequired: Choose a person or type a new name.

fx.unavailable: The exchange rate isn't available right now, so amounts are shown in MXN instead of {currency}.
